newsitem.title: USA: NYC Water Authority decides to sell bonds Oct 16.
newsitem.headline: NYC Water Authority decides to sell bonds Oct 16.

text.p: The New York City Municipal Water Finance Authority decided to go ahead with an approximately $371 million bond sale on October 16, a PaineWebber Inc official said on Friday.
The Authority had said it was considering delaying the sale by one week.

PaineWebber is senior manager and book runner for the negotiated bond offering. The PaineWebber official, who declined to be named, explained that the decision to sell the bonds next week was based on the view that both market conditions and the calender of new issuance were favorable.
"It just seems like a very good week for us to go," the official said.

He added that at a meeting this afternoon, the syndicate, which includes Goldman Sachs & Co and J.P. Morgan & Co, and the Authority will decide on whether to close the sale around October 24 or in the first week of November.
